Metadata.Goal: Compose OpenAI official Chat and DeepSeek official Chat from one pure Chat Completions core through two explicit effect bundles.
Metadata.Description: Replace provider heuristics and mutable mixed-responsibility stream logic with explicit official bundles, a pure reducer, and an effect shell.

TaskSpace.name: refactor-chat-completions-effect-bundles
TaskSpace.Description: Characterize, migrate into the AI domain, extract and explicitly compose provider-specific Chat Completions effects without changing observable provider behavior.

TaskGroup.name: Behavior and architecture characterization
TaskGroup.Description: Freeze provider selection, request projection, stream events and continuation behavior before refactoring.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Characterization tests cover explicit OpenAI/DeepSeek selection and current common stream semantics.
Tests fail for URL/model heuristic dependence or missing effect bundle contracts before production integration.

Task.name: Add effect bundle and pure-core characterization tests
Task.Description: Add focused tests for explicit end-to-end driver bundle selection, OpenAI isolation, DeepSeek continuation, Responses normalized-stream isolation, pure reducer determinism, event ordering and AI-domain package ownership.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests require OpenAI and DeepSeek drivers to expose distinct explicit official bundles.
Tests freeze common content/tool-call/think event ordering and final message behavior.
Tests require adapter selection to remain stable when model or Base URL strings are misleading.
Existing DeepSeek reasoning roundtrip regressions remain in the focused suite.
Tests prove the selected driver binding reaches ingress for main/child actor and provider-switch paths without stream-side adapter-type selection.
Package-boundary tests reject provider, reasoning and tool-call protocol ownership in symbiont-logic.

TaskGroup.name: Pure Chat Completions core
TaskGroup.Description: Extract deterministic stream projection and reduction into the AI domain, leaving symbiont with provider-neutral stream/runtime primitives.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Reducer tests pass without OutputStream or network dependencies.
The compatibility facade produces the same ingress events and assistant messages.

Task.name: Extract pure stream reducer and effect descriptions
Task.Description: Introduce AI-domain stream state and pure functions for chunk projection, fingerprinting, reasoning/content segmentation, tool-call reduction and message finalization; move the existing class facade/export into ai-organ-logic and migrate workspace imports without creating a symbiont reverse dependency.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Repeated input state/chunk values produce structurally equal reducer results.
The reducer does not read environment state or write OutputStreams.
Empty/mirrored reasoning, split think tags and incremental tool arguments preserve existing behavior.
The existing class name and ai-organ-logic public export remain available; workspace symbiont deep imports are migrated.
symbiont-logic no longer owns or exports code that interprets provider reasoning or tool-call fields.

TaskGroup.name: Official effect bundle composition
TaskGroup.Description: Define the provider contract and compose the common transport with explicit OpenAI and DeepSeek official implementations.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Both official drivers select their bundle explicitly.
No model/Base URL heuristic controls DeepSeek protocol behavior.
Responses API remains on its independent driver.

Task.name: Add official effect bundle contract and implementations
Task.Description: Add an AI-domain contract-level Chat Completions effect bundle shape and OpenAI/DeepSeek official logic implementations for endpoint, message/request projection and stream reasoning policy.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Contract and logic ownership follow existing contract/logic package boundaries.
OpenAI official bundle excludes DeepSeek compatibility fields.
DeepSeek official bundle preserves real reasoning and repairs only missing historical tool-call fields.
Bundle implementations reuse the shared core instead of copying its state machine.
Bundle contract and implementations introduce no ai-organ reverse dependency from symbiont packages.

Task.name: Integrate drivers and remove provider heuristics
Task.Description: Inject the official bundles from OpenAIChatDriver and DeepSeekDriver, pass the current request's actual adapter/driver binding through executor and terminal stream callbacks into ingress, and remove isDeepseekRequest plus stream-side adapter-type inference.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: ProviderDriverRegistry selection is the only source of OpenAI-versus-DeepSeek protocol semantics.
Misleading model/Base URL strings do not switch the configured bundle.
Explicit `adapter: deepseek` works with third-party compatible Base URLs.
OpenAI Responses, Anthropic and Claude Code driver paths are unchanged.
Normal provider runtime execution passes the exact selected driver bundle to stream reduction and never reconstructs it from llmClient.type or adapter strings.
Mocks and legacy direct entries either inject an explicit bundle or use the documented OpenAI-only compatibility default.
Responses native request/history/endpoint logic remains outside both Chat Completions bundles while its normalized ingress projection stays compatible.

TaskGroup.name: Cross-provider verification
TaskGroup.Description: Run focused and architecture regressions, review boundaries and record migration evidence.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Focused stream, transport, driver registry, executor/terminal binding, ingress and DeepSeek continuation tests pass.
Strict Codument and decision validation pass.
Diff review confirms no session rewrite and no Responses protocol merge.

Task.name: Verify provider bundle boundaries and regressions
Task.Description: Add architecture guards, run the relevant package and terminal tests/type checks, and document objective evidence and any environment limitations.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Focused OpenAI/DeepSeek transport and stream tests pass.
Provider registry, ingress semantic shape and package-boundary tests pass.
No production URL/model heuristic remains for DeepSeek bundle selection.
Strict track and decisions validation pass.
No production stream path selects Chat Completions bundle semantics from adapter type or duplicates provider policy across symbiont and ai-organ.
